name: Yoga school in Chiang Mai
reason: No suitable school within the two-candidate limit. First candidate, Yoga Ananda Chiang Mai (yogaananda.net, Nimmanhaemin), runs a 200-hour training (Aug 2027) but its own pages sell it largely on fitness and therapy (therapeutic and rehab yoga, 'fat burn' classes, aerial and Pilates training, a founder story of recovering from named conditions), so it fails the health-and-fitness rule. Second candidate, True Nature Chiang Mai (truenaturecm.com, RYS 200, 45-50 minutes north of the city), is a family-run retreat homestay whose own site offers only the 200-hour training (June and September 2027, fees on request) and rolling retreat stays, with no classes, free resources or embedded videos: a retreat rather than a school, and under the ~3 item minimum. For you to decide: True Nature could be listed if a retreat-based school with two items is acceptable.
